description: Aeon is an open-source autonomous agent framework that runs scheduled skills in the operator’s own GitHub repository using GitHub Actions. Aeon Connect provides a hosted dashboard and remote MCP access for driving that self-hosted agent.
summary: Aeon exposes one public agent-facing HTTP API at https://www.aeon.fun/v1 with an OpenAPI spec, plus two MCP servers: a public read-only docs server at /mcp and an OAuth-protected Aeon Connect MCP server at /connect/mcp.
